name: math_reasoning_benchmark_scaling_hint-gen
description: A research benchmark that measures a model's ability to generate useful hints that aid in solving mathematical reasoning problems. It evaluates hint-generation quality and whether produced hints improve downstream solver performance, focusing on methods for scaling reasoning via intermediate guidance. The benchmark is intended for studying how generated auxiliary information affects solution success rates.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in math-reasoning and hinting studies; modest adoption in the academic community exploring reasoning augmentation techniques.
